title: HD Consortium Automatic Abbott Blood Analyzer, Model Name/Number: Hdc-lyte Plus
parameters: pH , pCO₂, pO₂, Na⁺, K⁺, Cl⁻
desc: The HD Consortium HDC-LYTE Plus is a fully automatic Blood Gas and Electrolyte Analyzer designed for rapid and accurate analysis of critical care samples. It uses Ion Selective Electrode (ISE) and amperometric sensor technology to measure blood gas, electrolyte, and metabolic parameters. The analyzer features an Android-based touchscreen interface, automatic calibration, built-in thermal printer, LIS connectivity, RFID-enabled reagent cartridges, and unlimited data storage. It is suitable for hospitals, emergency departments, ICUs, operation theatres, and clinical laboratories.
